text: Holmes's account of Brown's morning, which Brown admitted
why: Holmes says he described Brown's actions that morning, and Brown 'gave it up', which is an admission.
Holmes says Brown's own boots exactly matched the square-toed impressions.

text: Tuesday, early morning: the horse near Mapleton
why: The crime was Monday night, with Straker leaving at 1 a.m. 'That morning', when Brown was first down and saw the horse, is therefore early Tuesday.

text: Tuesday, early morning: the horse led into Mapleton
why: Holmes describes Brown leading the horse back and hiding it at Mapleton that same morning.
